text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Kepler Energy sent an onboarding request for a custom 13B model to power outage summarization and triage. They need Private deployment with HSM for PII/PHI, weekly evals, and a canary in Dedicated. Can ops + safety estimate effort/timeline? (cc @ivan @devon @ellie) :wave:

ivan: Can you drop the model artifact link + expected QPS and avg seq len? Also is it quantized or fp16?

maria: Model link (customer-hosted): https://kepler-secure.s3/kepler-13b/v1/model.pt — LZ4 compressed tar. Target steady QPS ~12 req/s, peak ~40. Avg seq ~480 tokens. They prefer fp16 but ok with 4-bit quant if quality holds.

devon: Dedicated pool sounds fine. We'll need an HSM ticket + VPC peering. Operational ask: reserve 3xA10s for the canary, set autoscale to 8 GPUs at throughput >30 req/s. If they want fully on-prem private, infra lead time ~4–6 weeks (procure + network). :calendar:

ellie: Safety quick check: what's in training data? Any scraped public forums or third-party PII sources? We need a red-team plan, a prompt-safety suite, and hallucination/regression baselines. Also request: echo-suppression tests for PHI and a token-filtering policy. Please share a small sanitized sample.

maria: They said training corpus = internal outage logs + vendor maintenance notes + contractor email threads. Customer flagged potential PHI in contractor emails. I'll ask them for a sanitized sample set today. FYI Kepler is in renewal window (~6 months). They're flagged as medium churn risk if onboarding slips — they tied this rollout to a feature launch.

safety-bot: Safety checklist: https://redwood.internal/safety/checklists/custom-onboard — required items: red-team plan, prompt-suite, differential-quality tests, hallucination F1, toxicity scan, data lineage doc.

ikanote: (automated) baseline test suggestion: run differential generation on the vendor-note subset to check for named-entity leakage.

ivan: I'll scaffold the eval harness and run an initial quality pass. Proposed local command to run the outage prompt suite:
```bash
./eval_harness/run_eval.sh --model /tmp/kepler-13b --suite outage_prompt_suite.json --quantize 4 --out results/kepler.csv
```
I'll run a smoke test tonight and post metrics (ROUGE, hallucination-rate, avg latency).

deploy-bot: Canary tentative: 2024-11-18 09:00 UTC — pending HSM ticket and safety sign-off.

maria: Thanks everyone — priority: create HSM/VPC ticket, get sanitized samples for safety, and schedule the canary gating meeting. I'll collect the customer eval checklist and attach to this thread. :thumbsup:
